api_host: https://api.americanwagering.com (Cezar's/William Hill 'American Wagering' platform; fronted by CloudFront+istio-envoy)

required_headers.x-aws-waf-token: <AWS WAF browser token; present on requests that got 200>

pattern_verdict: ONE-SHOT-PER-LOAD: 16 total api.americanwagering.com requests over the whole page lifetime (~3 min observed), each endpoint fired exactly once (banners retried once), zero repeats/polling afterwards. Data is fetched by GET-per-route, not streamed/polled.
bundle_derived_endpoints: GET /sb/v4/sports/{sportId}/competitions/{competitionId}/tabs[/tabs/{tab}/secondary/{tab2}]  (V4DtosSportPageDtoSchema - carries the whole odds board)
waf_note: v4 odds endpoints returned 403 (CloudFront/AWS WAF 'The request could not be satisfied') from both the browser session and curl in most attempts; one curl burst returned 200 with 644,729 bytes for /sb/v4/home and 200/7022 for /sb/v3/navigation-items, and /sb/v3/sports-menu 200 via CloudFront cache hit. So the API is reachable but rate/edge gated.
apex_note: No 'apex'/'APEX' identifier exists anywhere in sportsbook.caesars.com HTML, /us/config/czr/*.json, or the 9.8MB main bundle (only a false-positive inside a base64 blob). The Caesars odds API is the americanwagering.com sb v3/v4 API.
